Leah (Events): Quick check: tomorrow's studio rehearsal notes. Need mic order, 30s demo handoffs, and a verified fallback asset.

Tom (Producer): Proposed mic order: Host -> Speaker -> Panel. Handoffs: 30s max on stage transfer. CueBot: rolling countdown set for rehearsals.

Rhea (Host): I'll open with a 45s framing and two segues: to the demo, then panel. Can someone add a slide with the "try-in-docs" fallback CTA?

Carlos (Speaker): I'll compress demo to 3m if asked. backup recording at assets/fallbacks/demo_trim.mp4. mic: laptop + headset ok.

Maya (Eng): I'm on standby for live demo. If latency >8s, Tom switch to fallback clip and we run the short Q prompt.

Leah (Events): Slide freeze: EOD today. Tom, schedule green room at 30 min before show. CueBot: reminder -> 1747654500.

Tom (Producer): Got it. Rehearsal run (20m): 1) host intro 2) demo run 3) quick panel 4) live Q triage. Keep transitions tight.

Rhea (Host): Sounds good. I'll do a practice handoff at 10:15 PT.

Carlos (Speaker): :thumbsup: see you then.

Maya (Eng): I'll monitor infra and post in the private ops thread if anything pops.

Leah (Events): Thanks all — last reminder, upload any new slides now or they won't make the vfinal.
